title: Coefficient projection cocycle for ordinary derived ringed diagrams
statement:
Let $u:\mathscr X\to\mathscr Y$ be a morphism of topoi presented by small sites [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism, def-weil-size-convention]. On $\mathscr Y$ fix composable homomorphisms $A\xrightarrow{a}B\xrightarrow{b}C$ of sheaves of commutative rings. On $\mathscr X$ use their inverse images $A_X,B_X,C_X$, including the induced ring maps. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], K-flat derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and the canonical derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Write $S_a^T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$, $S_b^T=-\otimes^L_{B_T}C_T$, $S_{ba}^T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}C_T$ for $T=X,Y$, and $G_D=Ru_{*,D}$ for $D=A,B,C$. Let $\tau_T:S_b^TS_a^T\xrightarrow{\sim}S_{ba}^T$ be balanced tensor associativity [lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization].

Define $\chi_a:S_a^YG_A\to G_BS_a^X$ to be the $u_B^{-1}\dashv G_B$-adjunct of
$$u_B^{-1}S_a^YG_AM\xrightarrow{\sim}S_a^Xu_A^{-1}G_AM\xrightarrow{S_a^X\varepsilon_{A,M}}S_a^XM,$$
using the canonical inverse-image/tensor comparison; define $\chi_b,\chi_{ba}$ in the same way. Then the following identity of natural transformations holds:
$$\chi_{ba}\circ\tau_YG_A=G_C\tau_X\circ(\chi_bS_a^X)\circ S_b^Y\chi_a.$$
For an identity coefficient map $\chi$ is the identity under multiplication by the coefficient unit. Consequently, if a commutative square of coefficient ring sheaves $A\to B$, $A\to C$, $B\to D$, $C\to D$ has equal composites $A\to D$, the two successive projection comparisons to $D$ agree under their balanced tensor identifications. These equalities are natural in the ring maps, commute with the canonical cochain shifts, and hold in the target coefficient derived category. No flatness or invertibility of any $\chi$ is assumed.

The same assertions hold on the ordinary derived categories of strict inverse systems of module sheaves for compatible maps of ring systems: use the ringed diagram topoi of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization] and the operations of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. The identities are identities there before evaluation or total inverse limit.

source.place: Tag 0E47, remark-compose-base-change-horizontal (horizontal composition of the base change maps of Tag 07A7, remark-base-change), applied to the coefficient-change morphisms of ringed topoi $(\mathscr T,C_T)\to(\mathscr T,B_T)\to(\mathscr T,A_T)$ over $u$, whose base change maps are the $\chi$ of the statement and whose pullback composition is balanced associativity $\tau$; Tag 0D6E, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition, for the ordinary derived adjunctions. Stacks omits the verification; the unit clause, the diagram-topos clause and the shift clause are agent supplements. Motivation: Bhatt–Scholze 6.7.16–6.7.17.
